ideas.title: The Last Train Home
ideas.one_sentence_premise: Twenty years after her younger brother vanished on Platform Nine, night cleaner Nora finds wet footprints coming from the locked platform and a timetable that prints two tickets for tomorrow's final train.
ideas.hook: Platform Nine has been sealed since Elias vanished. So who left wet footprints coming from inside it?
ideas.twist: No train returns Elias; the station's dead timetable prints, 'You can go home now, Nora,' and the footprints lead away from the platform, ending her vigil.
